text.p: Investors should buy shares of Polish construction firm Elektrobudowa SA, which should benefit from increased spending in the energy sectory, Flemings Research in London said in a report dated July 10.

"We view the stock as a buy at current levels of 50 zlotys and would view any weakness over the summer months and election period a major buying opportunity," the report said, referring to the parliamentary elections due on September 21.
The stock, which Flemings saw trading at a 12 percent discount to non-banks on the Polish market at the time of the report, closed on Wednesday at 48.5 zlotys.
Flemings saw the annual growth rate of the energy sector at 25 percent until the year 2000.
It said Elektrobudowa should lift net profit to 16.5 million zlotys this year, 19.4 million zlotys next year and 24.5 million zlotys in 1999 from 14.3 million in 1996.
Sales should rise to 272 million zlotys this year, 326 million zlotys next year and 392 million zlotys in 1999 from 218 million in 1996.
